patch_description: This search spends a modest share of the LP budget scoring diverse repaired starts, then uses bottleneck-focused degree-preserving exchanges and occasional three-link rotations to explore their neighborhoods. Surrogate energy screens proposals, while an annealed parent-selection rule and bounded archive help the search escape repeatedly stalled regions. It also occasionally proposes a few exchanges toward a distant strong archive member, enabling limited path relinking without letting it dominate the search. LP evaluations are deduplicated, and the best evaluated network is always returned.
